worldcombat.skill.quash.summary: Try to interrupt an interruptible preparation and deny a limited number of subsequent attempts. Movement remains slowed during the effect.
worldcombat.skill.quash.description.0: Sends a press of force at the aim point up to %1$s blocks away with a %2$s block collision radius; it affects only the first non-ally it strikes, and fizzles if terrain or an ally blocks the way.
worldcombat.skill.quash.description.1: Try to interrupt an interruptible action and suppress the target for %1$s. Deny its next %2$s attempts; one native projectile or damage delivery spends only one denial. After those are spent it can act normally while the remaining slow expires or is cured.
worldcombat.skill.quash.use.0: Break a move the target is charging
worldcombat.skill.quash.use.1: Steal a beat and hold your ground
worldcombat.skill.quash.use.2: Slow a target that charges you down
worldcombat.skill.quash.preference.crush: On: a longer suppression window (duration x1.3) that pins longer, at the cost of 20 extra ticks of cooldown. Off: a lighter press, shorter (x0.8) but 8 ticks cheaper, to steal beats more often.
worldcombat.skill.quash.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of pressing. Larger values chase harder and whiff more in the open.
worldcombat.skill.quash.preference.ai.le: When on, the user may leave its post to press; when off, it only presses what it can reach from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.quash.description.addi: While quashed, the target's movement speed drops by 30% x (deflections + 1), so the more it is pressed the closer it comes to a standstill; hitting it again refreshes Quash and resets its deflection count.
worldcombat.skill.quash.timing: %1$s s wind-up, %2$s s recovery, %3$s s cooldown, costing %4$s PP.
